input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision anywhere in the body (searches for insurance, coverage, certificates, workers' compensation, E&O and cyber return nothing), and there are no exhibits attached. Kubient is a hosting/services vendor that under paragraph 9(b)(iii) undertakes the "collection, maintenance, management and storage of visitor information (data)" and serves creatives onto our Properties, so insurance is expected; absence for a vendor processing our data is walk-away territory. We therefore insert a short insurance paragraph as new clause 14(j), at the preferred limits (CGL USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, E&O USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy USD 5,000,000 where any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer is handled, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request), with fallback limits offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance provision in General Provisions
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance provision even though Kubient collects, stores and manages visitor data and serves ads on our Properties, so we have added a short insurance paragraph at our preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where our data is handled, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). If limits are an issue, we can fall back to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.

ops.text: Kubient shall maintain throughout the Term: (i) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (ii) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (iii) where Kubient processes, stores or otherwise handles any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (iv) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Kubient shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request.
